context: to black flag. == gameplay == assassin's creed rogue is an action-adventure, stealth game set in an open world environment and played from a third-person perspective. the game features three main areas: the western north atlantic (around the gulf of saint lawrence), the fictional river valley (partly inspired by the hudson valley), and new york city. the first two include numerous individual locations that can be explored, such as small islands, human settlements, naval forts, and shipwrecks. like assassin's creed iv: black flag, naval exploration and combat are a major component of the gamepl
